أنتمي (form VIII)
# أَنْتَمِي (ʔantamī) /ʔan.ta.miː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَمَى (intamā)
# أَنْتَمِيَ (ʔantamiya) /ʔan.ta.mi.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَمَى (intamā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
